name: The Mindless Ones
label: Quest
description: Shadow Priest Sarvis tasks newly awakened Forsaken with culling the Mindless Zombies and Wretched Zombies that wander the northern edges of Deathknell.…
intro: Shadow Priest Sarvis tasks newly awakened Forsaken with culling the Mindless Zombies and Wretched Zombies that wander the northern edges of Deathknell. These shambling corpses are Scourge thralls, devoid of free will and utterly bound to the Lich King's command.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the undead, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest of zombies, friend. Do not return until you have success to report.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.
But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
